Daily Quiz.question: ১) Who wrote the Novel 'Anna Karenina'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Leo Tolstoy is a Russian Novelist. His famous novels: War and Peace, Anna Karenina, Childhood, Resurrection etc. His famous drama is The power of Darkness. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Who is known as 'Poet of Love'?
Daily Quiz.exp: John Donne is a Metaphysical Poet. He is called the Poet of Love and Religious Poet. His famous poems are The Good Morrow, The Flea, The Ecstasy, The Sun Rising, The Canonization, Twicknam Garden, For Whom The Bell Tolls etc. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Who wrote the poem 'The Road Not Taken'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Robert Frost is an American national poet. His famous poems are The Road not Taken, A Way Out, Mending Wall, Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening, Christmas Trees, A Boy's Will, North of Boston, Nothing Gold Can Stay, After Apple-picking, Home Burial etc. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Shooting an Elephant is a ____ by George Orwell.
Daily Quiz.exp:
এটা Essay নাকি Short Story এটা নিয়ে বিতর্ক আছে। প্রশ্নটা এভাবেই অনেক জবের পরীক্ষায় এসেছে। Orwell Foundation এবং Orwell Researcher রা বেশীরভাগই এটাকে Essay হিসেবে চিহ্নিত করেন। অপশনে যেহেতু Eassay নেই তাই Short Story কে ঠিক ধরা হল। দুইটা একসাথে আসলে Essay দেয়াটা বেটার হবে।
George Orwell is an English novelist, essayist, journalist and critic. His real name is Eric High Blair. He was a police officer in Burma. Shooting an Elephant is a Short Story by George Orwell. His famous Novels are Animal Farm, Nineteen Eighty-Four, Burmese Days, Coming up for Air.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who wrote The Novel 'The Hamlet'?
Daily Quiz.exp: William Faulkner is an American novelist and writer. His famous works are The Hamlet (Novel), The Sound and the Fury, As I Lay Dying, Light in August, Absalom, Absalom!, Go Down Moses etc. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Who is the writer of 'Don Juan'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Lord Byron is called the Rebel poet of English literature. Don Juan is a famous epic of Byron. Famous books of Byron: Lara, Childe Harold, The Vision of Judgement, Hours of Idleness, Heaven and Earth. His famous poem Childe Harold's Pilgrimage. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Who wrote the Novel 'The Sun Also Rises'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Ernest Hemingway is an American novelist. He was awarded the Nobel prize in 1954 for literature. His famous novels are For Whom The Bell Tolls, The Old Man and The Sea, A Farewell to Arms, The Sun Also Rises, Death in the Afternoon, To Have and Have not. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Who wrote the Novel 'The Hunchback of Notre Dame'
Daily Quiz.exp: Victor Hugo is a French Poet, Novelist and Dramatist. His famous Novels are Les Miserable, Ninety-Three, The Hunchback of Notre Dame (First Novel), The Man Who Laughs. Autumn Leaves, Songs of the Twilight, Inner Voice, Rays and Shadows etc. his famous poems. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Who is famous for Dramatic Monologue?
Daily Quiz.exp: Robert Browning was a famous poet of Dramatic Monologue. His famous works are Dramatic Lyrics, Dramatist Personae, The Patriot, My Last Duchess, Andrea Del Sarto, The Pied Piper of Hamelin, The Ring and the Book, Rabbi Ben Ezra etc. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Who wrote the Novel 'Hard Times'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Charles Dickens is the greatest novelist in the Victorian Period. His famous novels are Hard Times, Our Mutual Friend, David Copperfield, Oliver Twist, Great Expectations, A Tale of Two Cities, The Christmas Carol, The Bleak House, The Old Curiosity Shop, The Pickwick Papers, The Mystery of Edwin Drood, Little Dorrit, The Battle of Life. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Which one is the first work of Alfred Tennyson?
Daily Quiz.exp: Lord Alfred Tennyson was famous for Melodious Language. His famous Elegy is In Memoriam which includes 131 Lyrics. His famous works are Two Brothers (First work), Two Voice, Oenone, Ulysses, Lotus Eaters, Locksley Hall, Tears Idle Tears, Tithonus, Palace of Art, English Idyll, The Falcon, Dora, Dream of Fair Women, The Lady of Shalott, Vision of Sin, Morte D'Arthur etc. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who is known as a pessimistic novelist?
Daily Quiz.exp: Thomas Hardy was a Pessimistic Novelist and Poet. His famous novels are A Pair of Bluest Eyes, Under the Greenwood Tree, The Return of the Native, The Mayor of Casterbridge, Tess of the d'Urbervilles, Far From the Madding Crowd, The Poor Man and The Lady, The Trumpet Major, Jude the Obscure etc. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Who wrote the poem 'The Excursion'?
Daily Quiz.exp: William Wordsworth known as Poet of Nature, Poet of Childhood, Lake poet. His famous poems- Lyrical Ballad, The Daffodils, The Prelude, Lucy Poem, Tintern Abbey, The Solitary Reaper, The Excursion etc. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Shelley mourns over the death of John Keats in his famous elegy-
Daily Quiz.exp: Shelley mourns over the death of John Keats in his famous elegy Adonais. Shelley is known as Revolutionary Poet, Lyrical Poet, Poet of Wind and Poet of Hope and Regeneration. He was expelled from Oxford University for atheism. He was drowned while he was crossing the Adriatic Sea in 1822. Famous works of Shelley: Prometheus Unbound, Adonais, A Defence of Poetry, Ode to the West Wind, To a Skylark, Alaster, Ozymandias, Queen Mab, The Cloud. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Who is the writer of 'Ode to a Nightingale'?
Daily Quiz.exp: John Keats is called the Poet of Beauty. His famous works: Endymion, Hyperion, Lamia, Ode to a Nightingale, Ode to Autumn, The Eve of St. Agnes, Ode to Psyche etc. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Who wrote the Novel 'Mansfield Park'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Jane Austen is called an Anti-romantic novelist in the Romantic age because of her stern attitude against youthful passion. Her famous novels are Pride and Prejudice, Sense and Sensibility, Mansfield Park, Emma, Persuasion etc. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) 'Robinson Cruse' is a ____ written by Daniel Defoe.
Daily Quiz.exp: 'Robinson Cruse' is a Novel which is written by Daniel Defoe. His another famous novel is Captain Singleton. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Who wrote the poem 'Christabel'?
Daily Quiz.exp: S. T. Coleridge is a Romantic poet. He is known as the Poet of Supernaturalism, Lake Poet and Opium Eater. His important writings are Biographia Literaria, The Rime of the Ancient Mariner, Christabel, Kubla Khan, Dejection: An Ode etc. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Who wrote the play 'The Magnetic Lady'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Ben Jonson Comedies are known as 'Comedy of Humors'. His famous writings are The Magnetic Lady, Volpone, Every Man Out of His Humour, Every Man in His Humour, The Silent Woman, The Alchemist, The Devil is an Ass etc. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Who wrote the play 'The Land of Promise'?
Daily Quiz.exp: William Somerset Maugham is a novelist playwright and story writer. He wrote the play 'The Land of Promise'. His famous Novels are Of Human Bondage, The Sacred Flames, The Razor's Edge, Cakes and Ale, The Musician, The Moon and Sixpence, Lady Frederick. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) Who wrote the poem 'To his Coy Mistress'?
Daily Quiz.exp: The famous poems of Andrew Marvell are To His Coy Mistress, The Definition of Love, The Garden etc. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) Who is known as 'Great Master of Verse'?
Daily Quiz.exp: John Milton is a writer of Caroline Age. He is called Epic Poet and also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'. His famous Epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) Who is the writer of 'The Holy War'?
Daily Quiz.exp: John Bunyan is the powerful writer of Puritan Period. He is famous for his allegory. His famous writings are Pilgrim's Progress, The Holy War, The Life and Death of Mr. Badman. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) 'Love for Love' was written by-
Daily Quiz.exp: William Congreve was famous for Comedy of Manners. His famous plays: The Way of The World, Love for Love, The Double Dealer, The Old Bachelor etc. On the other hand All for Love is written by John Dryden. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) Who is called 'Mock Heroic Poet'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Alexander Pope is called Mock Heroic Poet. Famous epics of Alexander Pope is The Rape of the Lock. His famous works- An Essay on Criticism, The Dunciad, The Imitation of Horace, An Essay on Man, Letter to Gay. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) Who wrote the novel 'Tom Jones'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Henry Fielding regarded. His famous Novels are Tom Jones, Amelia, Joseph Andrews, Jonathan Wilde, Top Secret. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) Oliver Goldsmith is a/an ____ novelist, playwright and poet.
Daily Quiz.exp: Oliver Goldsmith is an Irish novelist, playwright and poet. His famous works are The Citizen of the World, The Traveller, The Vicar of Wakefield, The Deserted Village, The Good Natured Man, She Stoops to Conquer. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) Who wrote the play 'Heartbreak House'?
Daily Quiz.exp: George Bernard Shaw is the Greatest Modern Dramatist and called the father of modern English Drama. He is famous for his 'Drama of Ideas'. He was awarded the Nobel prize in 1925. His famous plays are The Philanderer, Arms and the Man, Man and Superman, Doctor's Dilemma, Major Barbara, Heartbreak House, The Devil's Discipline, The Apple Cart, St. Joan, Pygmalion, Caesar and Cleopatra, You Never Can Tell. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) Who wrote the Short Story 'The Jungle Book'?
Daily Quiz.exp: Rudyard Kipling Born in India. He is the first British to win a Nobel prize in 1907. He is mainly a Short Story writer. His famous works are Kim, The Jungle Book (Short Story), Plain Tales from The Hills, The Tomb of His Ancestors, The Man who was, The Mark of the Beast etc. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) Who wrote the poem 'Journey to the Magi'?
Daily Quiz.exp: T. S. Elliot is an American Born British poet Dramatist and Social Critic. He is famous for his Theory of Objective correlatives. Famous poem of T.S. Eliot are The Waste Land, Journey to the Magi, Ash Wednesday, Four Quarters, The Hollow Man, Portrait of a Lady. His famous drama are Murder in Cathedral, The Family Reunion, The Cocktail Party, The Elder Statement. Source: Live MCQ Lecture.
